email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketeer Endpoint Solutions role at Ingram Micro in Belgium. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I'm drawn to the opportunity to manage vendor-funded marketing initiatives and drive growth across endpoint technologies.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I've handled on-page SEO, content creation, and CMS management for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to track performance. I've also built and optimized websites in WordPress, implemented structured data, and coordinated multiple projects simultaneously. While my experience hasn't been in endpoint solutions specifically, I've developed strong project management and budget coordination skills, and I'm confident in my ability to translate vendor objectives into measurable marketing programs.

I'm fluent in English and eager to bring my creative and analytical mindset to Ingram Micro's marketing team. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your needs.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm excited to apply for the Marketeer Endpoint Solutions position at Ingram Micro. As a digital marketer with a technical edge, I've spent the past years building and optimizing websites, managing content, and using data to drive measurable results. The chance to focus on endpoint solutions—notebooks, peripherals, printing, and workplace technology—and to work with leading vendors in a collaborative international environment is exactly the kind of challenge I'm looking for.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage multiple client projects simultaneously, from SEO and content strategy to CMS management and reporting. I've coordinated marketing initiatives end-to-end: planning, execution, and performance tracking using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. For example, I built and optimized a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits that measurably improved search health. I've also worked on e-commerce stores, managing product catalogues and blog content, which taught me to balance creativity with structured processes—a skill I know is vital for vendor-funded marketing programs.

While my experience hasn't been in endpoint technologies specifically, I bring a strong foundation in project management, budget coordination, and stakeholder communication. I'm fluent in English and comfortable working independently, and I enjoy translating ideas into campaigns that deliver tangible results. I'm eager to learn the endpoint portfolio and contribute to Ingram Micro's growth.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your marketing team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
